messages:
Leah (AE): FYI Arcadia Health execs pushed for contract this week. Procurement says legal/CISO needs final answers on KMS + SOC2 scope before they sign. Can we get a go/no-go?
Omar (Solutions Eng): What exact KMS ask? Is customer asking BYOK with client-managed keys?
Leah (AE): Yes, they want BYOK + key residency in us-west-2. Also asked for evidence of SOC2 scope covering Dedicated. Procurement also requested throughput SLO for POC (10k reqs/day, p95 < 200ms).
Marta (Security): BYOK + key residency is doable for Private, for Dedicated we can provide customer-managed keys via our KMS integration. Need to confirm HSM attestation. I'll own the CISO packet.
Jiya (Backend Eng): For p95 200ms at 10k/day we need dedicated pool or reserved capacity with autoscale pre-warm. Recommend Dedicated S (2x A10) for POC. Can we get budget?
Leah (AE): Customer won't sign unless price cap is included for POC. They asked for a one-month trial credit + capped hourly rate.
Carl (Head of Sales): We can offer $8k credit + a tentative burn cap. Need legal to sign off — finance needs a quick model.
Nate (Product): Note: we have a current fallback policy to open model if Dedicated is saturated. Could include in runbook. Also clarifying that prefix caching will reduce cost.
Marta (Security): I'll attach CISO packet by EOD. Need sample attestation from KMS vendor — @contracts-bot can you attach previous attestation?
contracts-bot: Attached: /shared/attestations/redwood-hsm-attestation-2025.pdf :page_facing_up:
Omar (Solutions Eng): Also will prepare a minimal runbook for procurement showing network peering steps + IP allowlist windows.
Leah (AE): Timeline: customer expects signature by Wednesday. If security packet + pricing cap are ready by Tue noon, can we rally for exec signoff?
Carl (Head of Sales): I'll ping legal and finance — looping in @Marta and @Nate.
Marta (Security): One more ask from CISO: data retention policy export for PII. I'll include the extract.
Leah (AE): Thanks all. If anyone on call can join customer bridge tomorrow 10am PST, please shout.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll join.
Jiya (Backend Eng): Can join for technical Qs.
Nate (Product): Might be on travel, but will try to make it.
Carl (Head of Sales): I'll coordinate exec sync if needed.
